instructions: Fill a large pot with water, add the 1 tbsp salt and bring it to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, halve the cherry tomatoes. Cut the salami into small dice. Finely dice half the red onion and the whole red bell pepper. Transfer all of it to a large bowl.
Add the tortellini to the boiling water and cook for the time on the package, usually 3 to 5 minutes, until they float and the filling is hot.
Drain the tortellini and rinse them under cold water for 30 seconds, until they feel cool. Shake off the water.
Add the tortellini to the bowl with 1/2 cup of the Italian dressing, 2 tbsp grated Parmesan and 1 tbsp chopped parsley. Toss gently.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour. Tortellini soak up dressing as they sit, so before you eat, stir in a splash more dressing.
Pack it into 4 containers. It keeps in the fridge for up to 4 days and is good straight from the fridge.
